diagnosis: The gate failed because rollout 1 failed check C3, which is gated by fact PF3 (owner A4). In rollout 1, PF3 was revealed by A4 at turn 3 with the text 'must be unloaded third', the fact was cited in justification_fact_ids, and PF3 was in credited_facts -- yet C3 returned false. Comparing the settlements: rollouts 0, 2, and 3 (which passed C3) all placed 'generator air filters' in position 3 of the unloading_order array, while rollout 1 placed 'generator air filters' in position 2 (index 1), with 'water-treatment chemicals' pushed to position 3 (index 2). So the failure is an ENCODING MISMATCH: the model encoded the 'unloaded third' constraint as array index 1 (second position) rather than index 2 (third position), or C3's threshold/wording for detecting 'third' in the unloading_order is too strict relative to how the model naturally orders a four-element array when it says 'third.' No rollout hit the turn cap, no fact was never revealed, and no telepathy occurred -- the information surfacing and provenance worked across all four rollouts.

C3.why: The 1000 maintenance inspection reservation changes the air-filter pallet's unloading position to third and requires the maintenance pickup coordination action.
